description: Netbeheerder en gas energie-inhoud per gemeente is a dataset listed in Fluvius open data portal, an open data portal of a distribution network operator, published or maintained by Fluvius (Flanders). Overzicht van de netbeheerders en hun activiteiten actief per gemeente. Disclaimer: Fluvius spant zich in om volledige en actuele informatie aan te bieden. Niettemin kan Fluvius niet garanderen dat alle weergegeven informatie en data volledig of correct is. De informatie en data kunnen onvolledig zijn en fouten, vergissingen of omissies bevatten. Coverage: Belgium (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Services die Fluvius levert in opdracht van zijn DNB's. Its keywords are Energie-inhoud, Aardgas, Elektriciteit. The portal shows 2025-04-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open data license - FLUVIUS (https://opendata.fluvius.be/p/licentieopendatafluvius). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fluvius-open-data-portal.
